name: Malayan Cement Berhad
summary: Malayan Cement Berhad, an investment holding company, produces, manufactures, and supplies a portfolio of building materials for the construction industry in Malaysia and Singapore. It operates through two segments: Cement, and Aggregates & Concrete. The company offers cement and clinker, ready-mixed concrete, dry mix solutions under the Quickmix and ECODrymix brands, and aggregates, as well as waste management services converting waste streams into alternative fuels and raw materials for cement production.
